cases.case_label: Paternal Alu at BUB1B intron 8/exon 9 boundary
cases.disease: Premature chromatid separation/mosaic variegated aneuploidy (PCS/MVA) syndrome
cases.mechanism_detail: Fetus was compound heterozygous for a maternal BUB1B promoter point mutation and a paternal Alu insertion between intron 8 and exon 9; effect on splicing not described in abstract.
cases.quote: a paternal Alu sequence insertion between intron 8 and exon 9 of the BUB1B gene
